What we do

Used cars with part exchange

Quality used cars, serviced and cleaned before you collect. Your current car can be taken in part exchange.

Imports from the UK

From the UK to Limassol port: shipping, customs, MOT and registration, with every invoice in your name.

Paperwork and admin

Transfer of ownership, registration, road tax and duty-free eligibility. Quotes are free and without obligation.

Selling your car

Bought for cash or advertised on your behalf until it sells. Classic cars and motorbikes are a special interest.

In the showroom now

Vehicles from the dealership’s own website, September 2026.

Check the history yourself

Most used cars sold in Cyprus are Japanese and British imports. Independent online sources let you verify mileage history and body condition before you buy. All you need is the chassis number or the UK registration.

Imported from Japan

carvx.jp gives a detailed report with mileage history, previous use and body condition, about 20 to 25 euros, ready in one working day. japanstat.com and jpsheet.com are instant, about 5 euros, and show the last auction.

Imported from the UK

checkthecar.com checks the mileage history for free; a full history report costs less than 10 euros.

Neil, Alison and the showroom in Tremithousa

ANW Cars is a British family-run used car showroom, established in Cyprus in 2003 and run by Neil and Alison. It sits on Agios Neofytos Avenue in Tremithousa, just off the main road from Paphos to Polis. On Google, customers describe honest people who point out a fault before you buy and fix it before you collect, no sales pressure, and help with every form at the transport office. Several were new to Cyprus and say the whole process was made easy.

What customers say

Two of 27 Google reviews, 4.9 stars on average.

“Alison and Neil provided an outstanding service from start to finish. We first enquired a few years ago about shipping a car over from the U.K. Eventually we decided the best option was to buy a car locally and contacted ANW again. Having decided on the right car for us, nothing was too much trouble - a few minor repairs carried out, a discussion about what they needed from us, and all the paperwork and legal bits sorted out at the transport office. A car sales business as it should be run - no salesmen pressuring or confusing you, just good honest people providing an excellent service. Highly recommended by us.”
Lisa Britton · Google review
“We checked out nearly every single car dealer in paphos since we wanted to make the right decision and ANW Cars was by far the most trustworthy, friendly and helpful car dealer we talked to. When we did a test drive, the owner highlighted a minor problem with the suspension, which I would have never noticed since I’m not a mechanic, and then repaired it just before we bought the car. This was impressing, since all the other car dealers tried to hide all the problems that occur with used cars, of course. Also, they helped us with the whole paper work and told us exactly what to do, when to renew the car tax and all that kind of stuff. BIG RECOMMENDATION.”
Lukas Radatz · Google review
